content: {"promos": [{"title": "Betrayal at the Altar", "start_block": "B006", "end_block": "B047", "hook": "Juliana walks down the aisle to find her fiancé Gerald holding her sister Clarissa's hand at the altar.", "cliffhanger": "Clarissa smugly tells Juliana, 'Of course I knew,' revealing the conspiracy was planned all along.", "why": "It establishes the core conflict instantly: the villainous sister and the spineless fiancé betray the heroine in front of everyone.", "context_gap": "A stranger might not immediately know Clarissa is the sister, though the visual distinction is clear."}, {"title": "Family's Cruel Verdict", "start_block": "B063", "end_block": "B085", "hook": "The Matriarch commands Juliana to stop embarrassing the family, declaring Clarissa is the true jewel.", "cliffhanger": "Gerald turns his back on Juliana, coldly telling her, 'I cannot marry a woman of such plainness and low value.'", "why": "It maximizes the emotional stakes by showing the entire family unit turning against the heroine, culminating in a public insult.", "context_gap": "None. The power dynamic and the villainy of the groom are immediately clear."}, {"title": "The Final Straw", "start_block": "B081", "end_block": "B095", "hook": "Juliana looks directly at Gerald, who towers over her coldly, as the Matriarch declares Clarissa is the jewel.", "cliffhanger": "The ominous music swells as Juliana's face hardens with fury, cutting abruptly to black.", "why": "It provides a satisfying visual climax to the humiliation and sets up the heroine's transformation from victim to avenger.", "context_gap": "None."}], "moments": [{"start_block": "B020", "end_block": "B024", "kind": "hook", "description": "The camera pans across the pews of whispering guests as Juliana stops in the aisle, looking shocked at the altar."}, {"start_block": "B027", "end_block": "B029", "kind": "reveal", "description": "Clarissa beams with triumph and tells Juliana, 'Because he is marrying me,' as Juliana gasps in horror."}, {"start_block": "B041", "end_block": "B043", "kind": "cliffhanger", "description": "Gerald coldly states, 'I changed my mind,' as Juliana screams, 'You swore you loved me!'"}, {"start_block": "B094", "end_block": "B095", "kind": "cliffhanger", "description": "The ominous music swells as Juliana's face hardens with fury, cutting abruptly to black."}]}
